source: PSI-25_Experimental table_BASS-II.csv (UTF-8 with BOM, CRLF, 17 columns, 129 data rows)

rules.o2-missing: final O2 cell is empty or 'none'
rules.o2-impossible: final O2 > initial + 0.2, or initial - final > 5 (max real drop in BASS-II was 3.2)
rules.o2-rise-within-resolution: final O2 > initial by <= 0.2 (sensor resolution is ±0.1%: bass2.sensor.o2-res)
rules.co-over-range: final CO cell is 'OR', 'over', or starts with '>' (case-insensitive, whole cell)
rules.co-initial-over-range: same test on the initial CO cell
rules.co-missing: final CO cell is empty or 'none'
rules.co-negative: initial CO < 0 ppm (sensor zero drift; resolution 1 ppm)
rules.co2-missing: initial or final CO2 cell empty or 'none'
rules.co2-initial-zero: initial CO2 is exactly 0 (ISS air always has CO2; NASA table shows 0.00 too)
rules.date-gmt-mismatch: GMT day-of-year doesn't match the Date column
rules.date-year-2018: year outside the 2014/2016 campaign (NASA table also says 2018)
rules.note-would-not-stay-lit: Air/Fan display text contains 'would not stay lit'
rules.burnConfirmed: O2 usable and CO2 rose by >= 0.2% (2x the 0.1% CO2 resolution: bass2.sensor.co2-res)
